title: Initial host and boot configurations
statement: For a deterministic machine $S$, a nondeterministic machine $A$, a Boolean loop flag, and a Boolean input word $x$, the initial configuration of the host machine on $x$ equals the boot configuration formed from the initial configuration of $S$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a deterministic machine over Boolean symbols
$A$ is a nondeterministic machine over Boolean symbols
